channel.title: Comments on: 28% of Web Users Tag Content Online
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: Jens Meiert
item.dc:creator: Jens Meiert
item.description: I immediately bet that these numbers are just plain wrong. Considering that incredibly many people still think Yahoo or Google are “the Internet”, and that technology makes many things (unnecessarily) hard to use, every third person (even US wide) tags stuff? Nope. Take my annual income.
